[2] shipping.md > Packaging
## Packaging

Orders ship in plain brown cartons with the company logo stamped on one side. Gift orders can
include a handwritten note of up to 200 characters at no charge. The warehouse uses paper fill
and recycled corrugate; the only plastic in an outbound package is the carrier's label pouch and
the retail packaging the manufacturer supplied.

[3] faq.md > Can I send something back if I changed my mind?
### Can I send something back if I changed my mind?

Yes. You have 40 days from the day your order was delivered to return any unused item in its
original packaging with all its accessories. Start a return on the online store, or call us, and
you will get an RA number to put on the box.

[4] catalog.md > Ordering and availability
## Ordering and availability

Every item in this catalogue is stocked at the Hagerstown warehouse and ships from there. The
showrooms carry the full LED line, the Hagerstown Kerosene Lantern and the Heritage No. 7 on the
floor; the Northstar and the Sentinel 1000 Pro are kept in the back room and brought out on
request. An item shown as backordered on the online store ships in the order the orders were
placed, and the order confirmation gives the expected ship date. We do not charge a card until
the item ships.

[5] showrooms.md > What is stocked
### What is stocked

The Annapolis showroom leans toward what people on and around the water buy: the Sentinel 1000
and Sentinel 1000 Pro, the Firefly 220 and Firefly 220R, the Beacon 600, the Hagerstown Kerosene
Lantern in galvanized and black, the Heritage No. 7 and the Porchlight Solar. It does not stock the
Northstar Dual-Fuel on the floor, though it can be ordered for shipping, and it carries Clearburn
lamp oil and kerosene but not Clearburn white gas. Mantles, wicks and chimneys are stocked; globes
are ordered. No Second Light items.
